notes: 223 original SwiftDictionary questions: 138 knowledge, 15 word-definition and 70 Chinese-translation questions. The source pack intentionally remains draft. It contains 199 existing release-approved questions plus 24 Phase 6 draft-only questions; the latter remain unapproved and are not part of the release subset. The SQL exporter imports drafts by default; --approve-for-release generates selectable approved rows only under explicit owner authorization. Human bilingual accuracy review is deferred until live testing and friend feedback; structural validation does not certify educational accuracy.

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct verb: Everyone can ___ a mistake when they are tired.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的动词：人们疲倦时都可能___错误。
questions.explanation_learning: The standard collocation is “make a mistake.”
questions.explanation_translation: 标准搭配是“make a mistake”（犯错误）。

questions.prompt_learning: Which phrase means to stop working briefly and rest?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个短语表示暂时停止工作并休息？
questions.explanation_learning: “Take a break” is the standard expression for resting briefly.
questions.explanation_translation: “Take a break”是表示短暂休息的标准表达。

questions.prompt_learning: Which phrase is commonly used to say that you eat the morning meal?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个短语通常用来表示吃早饭？
questions.explanation_learning: We commonly say “have breakfast” when talking about eating the morning meal.
questions.explanation_translation: 谈到吃早饭时，英语通常使用“have breakfast”。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: I ___ my homework after dinner.
questions.prompt_translation: 完成句子：我晚饭后___作业。
questions.explanation_learning: “Do homework” is the usual verb-noun combination.
questions.explanation_translation: “Do homework”是常见的动词与名词搭配。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: She bought ___ umbrella.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：她买了一把雨伞。
questions.explanation_learning: “Umbrella” begins with a vowel sound, so the singular countable noun takes “an.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Umbrella”以元音音素开头，因此单数可数名词前用“an”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: ___ sun rises in the east.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：太阳从东方升起。
questions.explanation_learning: We use “the” for the unique sun in this context.
questions.explanation_translation: 在这个语境中，太阳是独一无二的，因此使用“the”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: He studies at ___ university in Kuala Lumpur.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：他在吉隆坡的一所大学学习。
questions.explanation_learning: “University” begins with the consonant sound /juː/, so “a” is correct.
questions.explanation_translation: “University”以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，因此使用“a”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: It was ___ honest mistake.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：那是一个无心的错误。
questions.explanation_learning: The “h” in “honest” is silent, so the word begins with a vowel sound.
questions.explanation_translation: “Honest”中的字母 h 不发音，因此该词以元音音素开头。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct plural form: one child, two ___.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的复数形式：一个孩子，两个___。
questions.explanation_learning: “Child” has the irregular plural form “children.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Child”的不规则复数形式是“children”。

questions.prompt_learning: Which phrase is correct in standard English?
questions.prompt_translation: 以下哪个短语符合标准英语？
questions.explanation_learning: “Advice” is uncountable in standard English; use “a piece of advice” for one item of advice.
questions.explanation_translation: 在标准英语中，“advice”是不可数名词；表示一条建议时可说“a piece of advice”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: How ___ apples do we need?
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：我们需要多少个苹果？
questions.explanation_learning: “Apples” is a plural countable noun, so the question uses “many.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Apples”是可数名词复数，因此疑问句使用“many”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: There isn't ___ water in the bottle.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：瓶子里没有多少水。
questions.explanation_learning: “Water” is uncountable here, so “much” is used in this negative sentence.
questions.explanation_translation: 这里的“water”是不可数名词，因此否定句中使用“much”。

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence follows the usual subject–verb–object order?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个句子符合常见的主语—动词—宾语语序？
questions.explanation_learning: “Mia” is the subject, “reads” is the verb, and “a book” is the object.
questions.explanation_translation: “Mia”是主语，“reads”是动词，“a book”是宾语。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word order.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词序。
questions.explanation_learning: The usual statement order is subject + verb + place phrase.
questions.explanation_translation: 常见陈述句语序是主语 + 动词 + 地点短语。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the simple-present question that correctly uses “does” with “he” and asks about working here.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的疑问句。

options.translation_text: 他现在正在这里工作吗？

questions.explanation_learning: With “does,” the main verb stays in its base form: “work.”
questions.explanation_translation: 使用“does”时，主要动词保持原形“work”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the sentence with the usual adjective position.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择形容词位置通常正确的句子。
questions.explanation_learning: In this noun phrase, the adjective “red” comes before the noun “bag.”
questions.explanation_translation: 在这个名词短语中，形容词“red”放在名词“bag”之前。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct present simple form: My brother ___ to school by bus.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的一般现在时形式：我哥哥/弟弟乘公共汽车去上学。
questions.explanation_learning: With a third-person singular subject such as “my brother,” the present simple verb takes -s or -es.
questions.explanation_translation: 主语是“my brother”这样的第三人称单数时，一般现在时动词通常加 -s 或 -es。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the grammatically correct negative sentence about coffee.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的否定句。
questions.explanation_learning: With “they,” use “do not/don't” followed by the base form “like.”
questions.explanation_translation: 主语是“they”时，使用“do not/don't”加动词原形“like”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct present-simple sentence that describes a regular habit.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择描述习惯的正确一般现在时句子。

options.learning_text: She walks to work every day.
She is walking to work now.
She will walk to work tomorrow.

questions.explanation_learning: “Every day” describes a regular habit, and “she” takes the verb form “walks.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Every day”表示规律习惯；主语“she”对应动词形式“walks”。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: We ___ dinner at home on Fridays.
questions.prompt_translation: 完成句子：我们星期五在家吃晚饭。
questions.explanation_learning: “We” takes the base present simple form “have.”
questions.explanation_translation: 主语“We”使用一般现在时动词原形“have”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct verb: Please ___ attention to the road.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的动词：请注意路况。
questions.explanation_learning: The standard expression is “pay attention.”
questions.explanation_translation: 标准表达是“pay attention”（注意）。

questions.prompt_learning: Which phrase means to do what you promised?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个短语表示履行自己的承诺？
questions.explanation_learning: “Keep a promise” means to do what you said you would do.
questions.explanation_translation: “Keep a promise”表示履行自己作出的承诺。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: It took us ___ hour to reach the station.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：我们花了一个小时到达车站。
questions.explanation_learning: The “h” in “hour” is silent, so the word begins with a vowel sound and takes “an.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Hour”中的 h 不发音，因此该词以元音音素开头，使用“an”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct article: She bought ___ useful dictionary.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的冠词：她买了一本有用的词典。
questions.explanation_learning: “Useful” begins with the consonant sound /j/, so the correct article is “a.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Useful”以辅音音素 /j/ 开头，因此使用“a”。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: There are two ___ of bread on the plate.
questions.prompt_translation: 完成句子：盘子里有两___面包。
questions.explanation_learning: “Two” requires a plural countable unit; “two slices of bread” is correct.
questions.explanation_translation: “Two”后需要可数名词复数；“two slices of bread”是正确表达。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the uncountable noun: How much ___ do we need for the recipe?
questions.prompt_translation: 选择不可数名词：这个食谱需要多少___？
questions.explanation_learning: “Sugar” is uncountable in this context, so it fits the question with “much.”
questions.explanation_translation: 在此语境中，“sugar”是不可数名词，因此可与“much”搭配。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct sentence: ___ three chairs in the room.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的句子：房间里有三把椅子。
questions.explanation_learning: “Three chairs” is plural, so the correct structure is “There are.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Three chairs”是复数，因此正确结构是“There are”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word to begin this present simple question: ___ you like music?
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词来开头，构成一般现在时疑问句：你喜欢音乐吗？
questions.explanation_learning: For a present simple question with the subject “you,” use the auxiliary “do.”
questions.explanation_translation: 一般现在时中，主语是“you”的疑问句使用助动词“do”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct present simple form: The shop ___ at nine every morning.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的一般现在时形式：这家商店每天早上九点开门。
questions.explanation_learning: “The shop” is third-person singular, so the present simple verb takes -s.
questions.explanation_translation: “The shop”是第三人称单数，因此一般现在时动词加 -s。

questions.prompt_learning: Which sentence uses “usually” before the main verb and says that she drinks tea in the evening?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个句子把频率副词放在主要动词之前，也就是它通常的位置？

options.learning_text: She usually drinks tea in the morning.
She drinks usually tea in the evening.
options.translation_text: 她在晚上通常喝茶（副词位置不自然）。

options.learning_text: She usually drinks tea in the evening.
She drinks tea in the evening every day.

questions.explanation_learning: Adverbs of frequency such as usually normally appear before the main verb: She usually drinks tea in the evening.
questions.explanation_translation: Usually 等频率副词通常放在主要动词之前：She usually drinks tea in the evening。

questions.prompt_learning: The new training programme should help employees ___ progress in their communication skills.
questions.prompt_translation: 新的培训计划应该帮助员工在沟通技巧方面取得进步。
questions.explanation_learning: The standard collocation is “make progress.”
questions.explanation_translation: 标准搭配是“make progress”（取得进步）。

questions.prompt_learning: The outdoor event was canceled because of ___ rain.
questions.prompt_translation: 由于下大雨，户外活动被取消了。
questions.explanation_learning: English commonly uses “heavy rain” for rain falling in large amounts.
questions.explanation_translation: 英语通常用“heavy rain”表示雨量很大。

questions.prompt_learning: Which verb means to complete work by the required date: ___ the deadline?
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个动词表示在规定日期前完成工作：___ 截止日期？
questions.explanation_learning: “Meet the deadline” means to finish the work by the required date.
questions.explanation_translation: “Meet the deadline”表示在规定日期前完成工作。

questions.prompt_learning: During the meeting, Maya ___ an important issue about customer support.
questions.prompt_translation: 会议期间，Maya提出了一个有关客户支持的重要问题。
questions.explanation_learning: “Raise an issue” means to bring a problem or subject to people's attention.
questions.explanation_translation: “Raise an issue”表示提出问题或让大家注意某个议题。

questions.prompt_learning: Given the clear weather forecast, it is ___ that the outdoor concert will be canceled.
questions.prompt_translation: 考虑到天气预报显示天气晴朗，户外音乐会被取消的可能性很小。
questions.explanation_learning: “Highly unlikely” is the natural collocation meaning very improbable.
questions.explanation_translation: “Highly unlikely”是自然搭配，表示极不可能。

questions.prompt_learning: Every team member must ___ responsibility for checking their own work.
questions.prompt_translation: 每位团队成员都必须为检查自己的工作承担责任。
questions.explanation_learning: The standard expression is “take responsibility for” something.
questions.explanation_translation: 标准表达是“take responsibility for”（对某事承担责任）。

questions.prompt_learning: The sudden drop in sales could ___ a serious problem for the business.
questions.prompt_translation: 销售额突然下降可能会给企业带来严重问题。
questions.explanation_learning: “Pose a problem” means to create or present a problem.
questions.explanation_translation: “Pose a problem”表示造成或带来问题。

questions.prompt_learning: The manager was ___ concerned about the safety report and asked for a review.
questions.prompt_translation: 经理非常关注安全报告，并要求重新审查。
questions.explanation_learning: “Deeply concerned” is a common collocation expressing serious worry.
questions.explanation_translation: “Deeply concerned”是常见搭配，表示非常担忧。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct completion: If the weather improves tomorrow, we ___ the match outside.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的句子补全：如果明天天气好转，我们将在户外比赛。
questions.explanation_learning: A first conditional uses a present-tense if-clause and “will” for a likely future result.
questions.explanation_translation: 第一条件句通常在 if 从句中使用现在时，并在可能发生的未来结果中使用“will”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct completion: If I ___ closer to the office, I would walk to work.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的句子补全：如果我住得离办公室更近，我就会步行上班。
questions.explanation_learning: The second conditional uses the past simple in the if-clause for an unreal or unlikely present situation.
questions.explanation_translation: 第二条件句用一般过去时表达不真实或不太可能发生的现在情况。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: ___ you leave now, you will miss the last train.
questions.prompt_translation: 完成句子：如果你现在不出发，就会错过末班车。
questions.explanation_learning: “Unless” means “if not,” so it expresses the condition that you do not leave now.
questions.explanation_translation: “Unless”表示“如果不”，这里指如果你现在不出发。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct zero conditional sentence about a general fact.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择描述一般事实的正确零条件句。

options.learning_text: If you heat ice, it melts.
options.translation_text: 如果加热冰，冰就会融化。

options.learning_text: If you heated ice, it will melt.
options.translation_text: 如果你加热冰，它将融化。

options.learning_text: If you heat ice, it would melt.
options.translation_text: 如果你加热冰，它会融化。

options.learning_text: If you will heat ice, it melts.
options.translation_text: 如果你将加热冰，它就会融化。

questions.explanation_learning: The zero conditional uses present simple in both clauses for general facts.
questions.explanation_translation: 零条件句通常在两个分句中都使用一般现在时来表达普遍事实。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct third conditional completion: If they had booked earlier, they ___ less.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的第三条件句补全：如果他们早点预订，他们当时就会花更少的钱。
questions.explanation_learning: The third conditional uses “would have” plus a past participle for an unreal past result.
questions.explanation_translation: 第三条件句用“would have”加过去分词表示与过去事实相反的结果。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the phrase that correctly completes the sentence: You may use the meeting room ___ you leave it clean.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的短语补全句子：只要你保持会议室整洁，就可以使用它。
questions.explanation_learning: “Provided that” introduces a condition that must be met.
questions.explanation_translation: “Provided that”引出必须满足的条件，意思是“只要”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct mixed conditional: If I had accepted the offer, I ___ in Singapore now.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的混合条件句：如果我当时接受了那份工作，我现在就会住在新加坡。
questions.explanation_learning: The past perfect describes the unreal past condition; “would be living” describes its present result.
questions.explanation_translation: 过去完成时描述与过去事实相反的条件；“would be living”描述它在现在产生的结果。

questions.prompt_learning: Could you ___ my dog while I am away this weekend?
questions.prompt_translation: 这个周末我不在时，你能帮我照看我的狗吗？
questions.explanation_learning: “Look after” means to take care of a person or animal.
questions.explanation_translation: “Look after”表示照顾某人或动物。

questions.prompt_learning: The meeting was ___ until next Monday because the director was ill.
questions.prompt_translation: 由于主管生病，会议被推迟到下周一。
questions.explanation_learning: “Put off” means to postpone an event or activity.
questions.explanation_translation: “Put off”表示推迟活动或事件。

questions.prompt_learning: We need to buy more milk because we have ___ it.
questions.prompt_translation: 我们需要再买一些牛奶，因为牛奶已经用完了。
questions.explanation_learning: “Run out of” means to have no more of something available.
questions.explanation_translation: “Run out of”表示某物已经用完。

questions.prompt_learning: Despite the interruption, the speaker ___ explaining the results.
questions.prompt_translation: 尽管被打断，演讲者还是继续解释结果。
questions.explanation_learning: “Carry on” means to continue doing something.
questions.explanation_translation: “Carry on”表示继续做某事。

questions.prompt_learning: At the end of the interview, the candidate ___ an important question about training.
questions.prompt_translation: 面试快结束时，候选人提出了一个有关培训的重要问题。
questions.explanation_learning: “Bring up” means to mention a topic for discussion.
questions.explanation_translation: “Bring up”表示提出一个话题供讨论。

questions.prompt_learning: She ___ the job offer because the position required frequent travel.
questions.prompt_translation: 她拒绝了这份工作邀请，因为该职位需要经常出差。
questions.explanation_learning: “Turn down” means to reject an offer or request.
questions.explanation_translation: “Turn down”表示拒绝提议或请求。

questions.prompt_learning: I usually ___ my new colleagues because we communicate openly and respectfully.
questions.prompt_translation: 我通常和新同事相处融洽，因为我们沟通坦诚且互相尊重。
questions.explanation_learning: “Get along with” describes having a friendly or successful relationship with someone.
questions.explanation_translation: “Get along with”表示与某人关系融洽。

questions.prompt_learning: I ___ in this neighbourhood for five years, and I still live here.
questions.prompt_translation: 我在这个社区住了五年，而且现在仍然住在这里。
questions.explanation_learning: The present perfect connects a situation that began in the past with the present; the sentence says it continues now.
questions.explanation_translation: 现在完成时把过去开始并延续到现在的情况联系起来；句子说明目前仍住在这里。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct sentence for a completed action at a finished time yesterday.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择描述昨天某个已结束时间内完成动作的正确句子。
questions.explanation_learning: “Yesterday” is a finished past time, so the past simple “saw” is used.
questions.explanation_translation: “Yesterday”表示已经结束的过去时间，因此使用一般过去时“saw”。

questions.prompt_learning: By the time we arrived at the cinema, the film ___.
questions.prompt_translation: 我们到达电影院时，电影已经开始了。
questions.explanation_learning: The film started before the later past event of our arrival, so the past perfect is used.
questions.explanation_translation: 电影开始发生在我们到达之前，因此使用过去完成时。

questions.prompt_learning: Lena ___ for three hours, and she is still studying now.
questions.prompt_translation: Lena已经学习了三个小时，而且现在仍在学习。
questions.explanation_learning: The present perfect continuous emphasizes an activity that began earlier and is still continuing.
questions.explanation_translation: 现在完成进行时强调一项较早开始并持续到现在的活动。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: I have worked at this school ___ 2020.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：我从2020年起就在这所学校工作。
questions.explanation_learning: “Since” introduces the starting point of a period that continues to the present.
questions.explanation_translation: “Since”引出持续到现在的一段时间的起点。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the negative present-perfect sentence using “yet” to show that the report is still unfinished.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择在现在完成时否定句中正确使用“yet”的句子。

options.learning_text: I haven't finished the report yet.
I haven't yet sent the report.
I don't have to finish the report yet.
options.translation_text: 我现在还不必完成报告。

options.learning_text: I hadn't finished the report by noon.
options.translation_text: 到中午时我还没有完成报告。

questions.explanation_learning: In a negative present perfect statement, “yet” commonly appears at the end after the past participle.
questions.explanation_translation: 在现在完成时否定句中，“yet”通常放在过去分词之后的句末。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the present-perfect sentence showing that all the guests left before now.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的句子，表示客人已经在现在之前离开。

options.translation_text: 客人当时已经在离开了。

questions.explanation_learning: The plural subject “guests” takes “have,” followed by the past participle “left.”
questions.explanation_translation: 复数主语“guests”使用“have”，后接过去分词“left”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the noun form of the verb “decide” to complete the sentence: Her ___ surprised everyone.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择动词“decide”的名词形式完成句子：她的决定让所有人都感到惊讶。
questions.explanation_learning: “Decision” is the noun form of “decide.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Decision”是动词“decide”的名词形式。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the adjective form of “rely”: We need a ___ source of information.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择“rely”的形容词形式：我们需要一个可靠的信息来源。
questions.explanation_learning: “Reliable” is the adjective describing something or someone that can be relied on.
questions.explanation_translation: “Reliable”是形容词，形容某事物或某人值得信赖。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct adjective: The project was ___ because it met all its goals.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的形容词：这个项目很成功，因为它达成了所有目标。
questions.explanation_learning: “Successful” is the adjective form used to describe the project.
questions.explanation_translation: “Successful”是用于描述项目的形容词形式。

questions.prompt_learning: The artist is known for her original ideas and great ___.
questions.prompt_translation: 这位艺术家以独特的想法和丰富的创造力而闻名。
questions.explanation_learning: “Creativity” is the noun for the ability to produce original ideas.
questions.explanation_translation: “Creativity”是名词，表示产生原创想法的能力。

questions.prompt_learning: The speaker tried to ___ the audience to support the proposal.
questions.prompt_translation: 演讲者试图说服观众支持这项提议。
questions.explanation_learning: After “tried to,” the base verb “persuade” is required.
questions.explanation_translation: “Tried to”后面需要接动词原形“persuade”。

questions.prompt_learning: The road becomes ___ at night, so drivers should slow down.
questions.prompt_translation: 这条路在夜间会变得危险，因此驾驶员应该减速。
questions.explanation_learning: “Dangerous” is the adjective describing the road.
questions.explanation_translation: “Dangerous”是用于描述道路的形容词。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the noun form of “accurate”: The ___ of the measurements is important.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择“accurate”的名词形式：测量结果的准确性很重要。
questions.explanation_learning: “Accuracy” is the noun form of the adjective “accurate.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Accuracy”是形容词“accurate”的名词形式。

questions.prompt_learning: Which verb most appropriately hedges this claim? “The initial results ___ that the new process may reduce delays.”
questions.prompt_translation: 哪个动词最适合用来谨慎表达这一主张？“初步结果___新流程可能减少延误。”
questions.explanation_learning: “Suggest” presents a possible interpretation without claiming definitive proof.
questions.explanation_translation: “Suggest”表达一种可能的解释，而不是声称已经得到确凿证明。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the cautious statement: The difference may be ___ to variation in the sample.
questions.prompt_translation: 补全谨慎表达：这种差异可能___样本中的变化。
questions.explanation_learning: “Partly attributable to” signals a possible contributing factor without claiming it is the only cause.
questions.explanation_translation: “Partly attributable to”表示某因素可能是部分原因，但不声称它是唯一原因。

questions.prompt_learning: Given the limited sample size, the findings should be interpreted ___.
questions.prompt_translation: 鉴于样本量有限，应当___地解读这些发现。
questions.explanation_learning: “Cautiously” appropriately signals that limited evidence should not support overconfident conclusions.
questions.explanation_translation: “Cautiously”恰当地表示证据有限，不应据此作出过度肯定的结论。

questions.prompt_learning: The observed pattern is ___ with previous studies, although the methods differ.
questions.prompt_translation: 观察到的模式与以往研究___，尽管研究方法有所不同。
questions.explanation_learning: “Consistent with” means the pattern agrees with earlier findings without claiming the studies are identical.
questions.explanation_translation: “Consistent with”表示该模式与先前研究结果相符，但不表示两项研究完全相同。

questions.prompt_learning: The increase in costs may ___ from changes in supplier prices.
questions.prompt_translation: 成本上升可能___供应商价格的变化。
questions.explanation_learning: “Stem from” means to originate from or be caused by something.
questions.explanation_translation: “Stem from”表示源自某事或由某事引起。

questions.prompt_learning: Without a larger comparison group, it would be ___ to claim that the treatment is more effective.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果没有更大的对照组，就断言该治疗方法更有效还为时___。
questions.explanation_learning: “Premature” indicates that the available evidence is not yet sufficient for the conclusion.
questions.explanation_translation: “Premature”表示现有证据尚不足以支持这一结论，现在下结论为时过早。

questions.prompt_learning: Because the estimates are based on a small sample, they remain ___.
questions.prompt_translation: 由于这些估算基于较小的样本，因此仍然具有___性。
questions.explanation_learning: “Tentative” describes a conclusion that is provisional and may change with further evidence.
questions.explanation_translation: “Tentative”表示暂时性的结论，可能会随着更多证据而改变。

questions.prompt_learning: The revised schedule is likely to have a ___ effect on overall costs rather than transform the budget.
questions.prompt_translation: 修订后的时间表可能只会对总成本产生___影响，而不会彻底改变预算。
questions.explanation_learning: “Modest effect” signals a limited degree of impact rather than a sweeping or certain outcome.
questions.explanation_translation: “Modest effect”表示影响程度有限，而不是全面或必然的结果。

questions.prompt_learning: The available evidence ___ suggests a link between sleep and concentration, but further research is needed.
questions.prompt_translation: 现有证据___地表明睡眠与注意力之间可能存在联系，但仍需要进一步研究。
questions.explanation_learning: “Tentatively” communicates that the evidence suggests a link but does not establish it conclusively.
questions.explanation_translation: “Tentatively”表示证据初步显示存在联系，但尚未作出决定性证明。

questions.prompt_learning: The survey results ___ the possibility that flexible hours improve staff retention.
questions.prompt_translation: 调查结果___了灵活工时可能提高员工留任率这一可能性。
questions.explanation_learning: “Raise the possibility” introduces a plausible explanation for consideration without confirming it.
questions.explanation_translation: “Raise the possibility”表示提出一种值得考虑的可能性，而不是确认其为事实。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: Not until the final report was published ___ the scale of the problem.
questions.prompt_translation: 补全句子：直到最终报告发布后，公众才___问题的严重程度。
questions.explanation_learning: A negative fronted phrase such as “Not until” triggers subject–auxiliary inversion in the main clause: “did the public understand.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Not until”等否定意义短语置于句首时，主句需要主谓倒装，使用“did the public understand”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct inversion: Rarely ___ such a detailed analysis of the issue.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的倒装形式：我们很少看到对这个问题如此详细的分析。
questions.explanation_learning: “Rarely” at the beginning of a clause requires subject–auxiliary inversion: “have we seen.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Rarely”置于句首时需要主谓倒装，因此使用“have we seen”。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: Only after the data had been checked ___ the team release the report.
questions.prompt_translation: 补全句子：只有在数据核查完毕后，团队才___发布报告。
questions.explanation_learning: When “Only after” introduces the fronted condition, the main clause uses inversion: “did the team release.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Only after”引导的条件短语置于句首时，主句使用倒装：“did the team release”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct formal inversion: Under no circumstances ___ confidential files with external parties.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的正式倒装结构：在任何情况下，员工都不应与外部人员分享机密文件。
questions.explanation_learning: “Under no circumstances” is a negative fronted phrase and requires inversion: “should staff share.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Under no circumstances”是否定意义的句首短语，需要倒装，使用“should staff share”。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the third conditional inversion: Had I known about the delay, I ___ an earlier train.
questions.prompt_translation: 补全第三条件句倒装结构：如果我当时知道会延误，我就会乘坐更早的一班火车。
questions.explanation_learning: “Had I known” replaces “If I had known”; the unreal past result takes “would have” plus a past participle.
questions.explanation_translation: “Had I known”相当于“If I had known”；与过去事实相反的结果使用“would have”加过去分词。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct completion: No sooner ___ than the lights went out.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的补全：我们刚坐下，灯就熄灭了。
questions.explanation_learning: The structure “No sooner had + subject + past participle + than” describes one event immediately followed by another.
questions.explanation_translation: 结构“No sooner had + 主语 + 过去分词 + than”表示一件事刚发生，另一件事就紧接着发生。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the sentence: Little ___ that the decision would reshape the industry.
questions.prompt_translation: 补全句子：他们当时完全没有想到，这项决定会重塑整个行业。
questions.explanation_learning: “Little” meaning “not at all” at the beginning of a clause triggers inversion: “did they know.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Little”表示“完全没有”并置于句首时会触发倒装，使用“did they know”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct structure: Not only ___ the budget, but it also reduced delays.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确结构：该计划不仅削减了预算，还减少了延误。
questions.explanation_learning: When “Not only” begins the clause, the auxiliary precedes the subject: “did the plan cut.”
questions.explanation_translation: “Not only”置于分句开头时，助动词要放在主语之前，使用“did the plan cut”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the passive inversion form that correctly completes: “At no point ___ of the change to the contract.”
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的补全：在任何时候，客户都没有被告知合同变更。

options.translation_text: 客户被告知了合同变更。
客户确实通知了相关人员。

questions.explanation_learning: The negative phrase “At no point” triggers inversion; the passive form is “was the client informed.”
questions.explanation_translation: 否定短语“At no point”触发倒装；此处被动语态应为“was the client informed”。

questions.prompt_learning: Complete the emphatic structure: So unexpected ___ that the committee requested a second review.
questions.prompt_translation: 补全强调倒装结构：结果如此出乎意料，以至于委员会要求进行第二次审查。
questions.explanation_learning: The “So + adjective” structure at the beginning triggers inversion: “So unexpected was the result that...”
questions.explanation_translation: “So + 形容词”结构置于句首时需要倒装：“So unexpected was the result that...”。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct mixed conditional: If I had accepted the scholarship, I ___ at university now.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的混合条件句：如果我当时接受了奖学金，我现在就会在大学学习。
questions.explanation_learning: The past perfect describes the unreal past choice; “would be studying” expresses its present result.
questions.explanation_translation: 过去完成时描述与过去事实相反的选择；“would be studying”表达该选择在现在产生的结果。

questions.prompt_learning: If she were more organised, she ___ the deadline yesterday.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果她更有条理，她昨天就不会错过截止日期。
questions.explanation_learning: The present unreal condition uses “were”; the unreal past result uses “would not have missed.”
questions.explanation_translation: 现在的非真实条件使用“were”；与过去事实相反的结果使用“would not have missed”。

questions.prompt_learning: If they had not moved abroad, they ___ here now.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果他们当时没有移居国外，他们现在就仍然住在这里。
questions.explanation_learning: The past perfect condition refers to an unreal past event, while “would still be living” gives the imagined present result.
questions.explanation_translation: 过去完成时条件指与过去事实相反的事件；“would still be living”描述假设中的现在结果。

questions.prompt_learning: If he had taken the medicine, he ___ better now.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果他当时吃了药，他现在就会感觉好一些。
questions.explanation_learning: The unreal past condition leads to a present result, so the main clause uses “would feel.”
questions.explanation_translation: 与过去事实相反的条件导致现在的结果，因此主句使用“would feel”。

questions.prompt_learning: If I were not afraid of heights, I ___ the climb last weekend.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果我不恐高，我上周末就会参加那次攀登。
questions.explanation_learning: The present unreal condition “were not afraid” explains a different possible past result: “would have joined.”
questions.explanation_translation: 现在的非真实条件“were not afraid”解释了一个不同的过去结果，因此使用“would have joined”。

questions.prompt_learning: If the company had invested earlier, it ___ a larger market share today.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果公司当时更早投资，它今天就会拥有更大的市场份额。
questions.explanation_learning: The past perfect describes the unreal earlier investment; “would have” describes the present state.
questions.explanation_translation: 过去完成时描述未发生的早期投资；“would have”描述假设中的现在状态。

questions.prompt_learning: If we had checked the map, we ___ lost now.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果我们当时查看了地图，现在就不会迷路了。
questions.explanation_learning: The unreal past condition affects the present state, so “would not be lost now” is the correct mixed result.
questions.explanation_translation: 与过去事实相反的条件影响现在的状态，因此正确的混合结果是“would not be lost now”。

questions.prompt_learning: If she spoke French fluently, she ___ the Paris assignment last year.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果她法语说得流利，她去年就会接受巴黎的任务。
questions.explanation_learning: The present unreal ability condition leads to an unreal past result, expressed with “would have accepted.”
questions.explanation_translation: 现在的非真实能力条件导致一个未发生的过去结果，使用“would have accepted”表达。

questions.prompt_learning: If the system were more reliable, it ___ during yesterday's outage.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果系统更可靠，它昨天停电期间就不会发生故障。
questions.explanation_learning: The present unreal condition “were more reliable” is linked to an unreal past result: “would not have failed.”
questions.explanation_translation: 现在的非真实条件“were more reliable”与一个未发生的过去结果相连，使用“would not have failed”。

questions.prompt_learning: If I had saved more money, I ___ a new laptop now.
questions.prompt_translation: 如果我当时存了更多钱，我现在就买得起一台新笔记本电脑。
questions.explanation_learning: The past perfect describes an unreal past saving habit; “could afford” expresses the present result.
questions.explanation_translation: 过去完成时描述与过去事实相反的储蓄情况；“could afford”表达现在的结果。

questions.prompt_learning: After months of planning, the team finally got the ball rolling. What does the idiom mean?
questions.prompt_translation: 经过数月规划，团队终于开始行动。“get the ball rolling”是什么意思？

options.learning_text: They began the activity or process.
options.translation_text: 他们开始了活动或流程。

questions.explanation_learning: “Get the ball rolling” means to start an activity, process or project.
questions.explanation_translation: “Get the ball rolling”表示启动一项活动、流程或项目。

questions.prompt_learning: The failed safety check was only the tip of the iceberg. What is implied?
questions.prompt_translation: 安全检查失败只是冰山一角。这句话暗示了什么？

options.learning_text: The problem is smaller than it appears.
The visible problem is part of a much larger one.
options.translation_text: 目前看到的问题只是更大问题的一部分。

options.learning_text: The problem has already been solved.
The issue is caused by cold weather.
options.translation_text: 问题是由寒冷天气造成的。

questions.explanation_learning: “The tip of the iceberg” refers to a small visible part of a much larger hidden situation.
questions.explanation_translation: “The tip of the iceberg”表示目前可见的只是更大隐藏情况的一小部分。

questions.prompt_learning: The contractor cut corners to finish the building sooner. What did the contractor do?
questions.prompt_translation: 承包商为了更快完成建筑工程而偷工减料。这表示承包商做了什么？

options.translation_text: 严格遵守了所有质量程序。

options.learning_text: Reduced quality or safety standards to save time or money.
options.translation_text: 为了节省时间或金钱而降低质量或安全标准。

options.learning_text: Added extra checks to the schedule.
options.translation_text: 在计划中增加了额外检查。

options.learning_text: Changed the design without changing the cost.
options.translation_text: 在不改变成本的情况下更改了设计。

questions.explanation_learning: “Cut corners” means to take shortcuts, often by sacrificing quality or proper procedure.
questions.explanation_translation: “Cut corners”表示走捷径，通常意味着牺牲质量或适当程序。

questions.prompt_learning: Before presenting the proposal, we should make sure everyone is on the same page. What does this mean?
questions.prompt_translation: 在提交提案之前，我们应该确保每个人都在同一认知上。这是什么意思？

options.translation_text: 每个人都有相同的理解。

options.learning_text: Everyone works in the same office.
options.translation_text: 每个人都在同一间办公室工作。

options.learning_text: Everyone has completed the same document.
options.translation_text: 每个人都完成了同一份文件。
每个人都同意所有细节。

questions.explanation_learning: “On the same page” means sharing a common understanding; it does not necessarily mean agreeing on everything.
questions.explanation_translation: “On the same page”表示拥有共同理解，但不一定意味着对所有细节都意见一致。

questions.prompt_learning: After the software update caused more problems, the team was back to square one. What happened?
questions.prompt_translation: 软件更新造成了更多问题后，团队又回到了原点。这意味着什么？

options.learning_text: The team had completed the project.
The team had to return to the beginning and start again.
options.translation_text: 团队不得不回到起点重新开始。

options.learning_text: The team had found a permanent solution.
options.translation_text: 团队找到了永久解决方案。

options.learning_text: The team had moved to a different office.
options.translation_text: 团队搬到了另一间办公室。

questions.explanation_learning: “Back to square one” means having to start again from the beginning.
questions.explanation_translation: “Back to square one”表示不得不从头开始。

questions.prompt_learning: She is on the fence about accepting the promotion. What does this mean?
questions.prompt_translation: 她对是否接受晋升仍然犹豫不决。这是什么意思？

options.learning_text: She is strongly opposed to it.
She has not decided whether to accept it.
options.translation_text: 她还没有决定是否接受。

options.learning_text: She wants someone else to receive it.

questions.explanation_learning: “On the fence” means undecided between alternatives.
questions.explanation_translation: “On the fence”表示在不同选择之间犹豫不决。

questions.prompt_learning: Losing the first contract seemed disappointing, but it became a blessing in disguise. What does this suggest?
questions.prompt_translation: 失去第一份合同起初令人失望，但后来却因祸得福。这暗示了什么？

options.learning_text: The negative event eventually led to an unexpected benefit.
options.translation_text: 这件负面事件最终带来了意想不到的好处。
这件事造成了永久损害。

options.learning_text: The event was planned as a celebration.
options.translation_text: 这件事原本是为了庆祝而安排的。

options.learning_text: The event had no effect on later events.
options.translation_text: 这件事对后续没有影响。

questions.explanation_learning: “A blessing in disguise” is something that seems bad at first but later produces a good result.
questions.explanation_translation: “A blessing in disguise”指起初看似坏事，后来却带来好结果。

questions.prompt_learning: I will not join the hike today because I am feeling under the weather. What does the phrase mean?
questions.prompt_translation: 我今天不参加徒步，因为我感觉身体不太舒服。这个短语是什么意思？
questions.explanation_learning: “Under the weather” is an informal expression meaning slightly ill or unwell.
questions.explanation_translation: “Under the weather”是非正式表达，表示身体有些不舒服。

questions.prompt_learning: The new safety measures may seem expensive now, but they will save money in the long run. What does “in the long run” mean?
questions.prompt_translation: 新的安全措施现在看起来可能很昂贵，但从长远来看会节省成本。“in the long run”是什么意思？

options.learning_text: Over an extended period of time.

questions.explanation_learning: “In the long run” refers to the eventual result over a long period of time.
questions.explanation_translation: “In the long run”表示经过较长时间后最终产生的结果。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: The company is looking for a more ___ way to package its products, using less material.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：公司正在寻找一种更___的产品包装方式，以减少材料使用。
questions.explanation_learning: “Economical” means using resources, money or materials efficiently; “economic” usually relates to the economy.
questions.explanation_translation: “Economical”表示有效节省资源、金钱或材料；“economic”通常与经济体系有关。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: The signing of the peace agreement was a ___ moment in the country's history.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：和平协议的签署是该国历史上一个___的时刻。
questions.explanation_learning: “Historic” describes an event that is important or significant in history; “historical” means related to the past or the study of history.
questions.explanation_translation: “Historic”形容具有重大历史意义的事件；“historical”表示与过去或历史研究有关。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: The new attendance rule may ___ how employees plan their shifts.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：新的出勤规定可能会___员工安排轮班的方式。
questions.explanation_learning: “Affect” is the verb meaning to influence; “effect” is most commonly used as a noun meaning a result.
questions.explanation_translation: “Affect”是表示影响的动词；“effect”最常用作名词，表示结果。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct verb: Please ___ a complete backup of all files before the server is replaced.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的动词：更换服务器前，请确保所有文件都已完整备份。
questions.explanation_learning: “Ensure” means to make certain that something happens or is true; “assure” usually means to tell someone confidently.
questions.explanation_translation: “Ensure”表示确保某事发生或属实；“assure”通常表示向某人作出保证。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: The museum director is an ___ expert on ancient ceramics.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：博物馆馆长是一位研究古代陶瓷的杰出专家。
questions.explanation_learning: “Eminent” means distinguished or highly respected; “imminent” means about to happen.
questions.explanation_translation: “Eminent”表示杰出或受人尊敬；“imminent”表示即将发生。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct verb: The organisation plans to ___ a new mentoring programme next year.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的动词：该组织计划明年___一项新的导师计划。
questions.explanation_learning: “Adopt” means to take up or begin using a plan or programme; “adapt” means to modify it.
questions.explanation_translation: “Adopt”表示采用或开始使用计划；“adapt”表示对其进行调整。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: The blue curtains ___ the warm colours in the room.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：蓝色窗帘与房间里的暖色调相得益彰。
questions.explanation_learning: “Complement” means to complete or enhance something; “compliment” means an expression of praise.
questions.explanation_translation: “Complement”表示补充或衬托；“compliment”表示赞美。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: The journalist was careful to be ___ when discussing the confidential negotiations.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：这名记者在讨论机密谈判时谨慎而审慎。
questions.explanation_learning: “Discreet” means careful and tactful, especially to avoid revealing private information; “discrete” means separate or distinct.
questions.explanation_translation: “Discreet”表示谨慎且得体，尤其指避免泄露私人信息；“discrete”表示分离或彼此独立。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the correct word: The witness gave a ___ account that matched the available evidence.
questions.prompt_translation: 选择正确的词：证人的陈述可信，并且与现有证据相符。
questions.explanation_learning: “Credible” means believable or worthy of trust; “credulous” describes someone too ready to believe things.
questions.explanation_translation: “Credible”表示可信或值得信赖；“credulous”形容一个人过于轻信。

questions.prompt_learning: Choose the most accurate Simplified Chinese translation of: “I usually have breakfast at home.”
questions.prompt_translation: 请选择最准确、最自然的简体中文翻译。

options.learning_text: I usually eat breakfast at home.
I ate breakfast at home yesterday.
I usually cook dinner at home.
I usually eat lunch at home.
